Applied at: proof storage (`add_proofs`), proof lookup (`select_proofs`), deposit accepted-mint check (`mod.rs`), send mint resolution (`send.rs`, keeping the recipient's raw string for the actual `u` tag — never rewritten, only the comparison is canonical), redeem accepted-mint check (`redeem.rs`), and the ledger's `TokenAdded` fact mint key in `token_event.rs`/`send_worker.rs`/`redeem_worker.rs` (so balances don't fragment into multiple rows for one real mint spelled two ways — this last part wasn't in your original checklist but a codex review round caught it as a real projection-correctness gap and I closed it). [...] (b) OUTGOING `u` TAG USES RAW URL — send_worker.rs builds `nutzap_event_tags(&mint, ...)` at line 246 from the raw recipient string; the `let mint = canonicalize_mint_url(&mint)` shadow is line 271, strictly AFTER tag construction and only feeds ledger fact + add_proofs. send.rs `.cloned()`s the recipient's raw string. NIP-61 exact-`u` preserved.

(c) NO LIVE SITE MISSED — swept the backend: send.rs:145, redeem.rs:179, mod.rs:340, state.rs select_proofs+add_proofs, and all 3 ledger-fact keys canonicalize. The 3 codex-caught bugs (trim_end_matches stripping ALL slashes / authority-split lowercasing a query / ledger fragmentation) are each fixed with a dedicated regression test. One out-of-scope note (NON-BLOCKING): nmp-nip60/src/nip60_wallet/nutzap_send.rs:191 still does raw `r.mint_url == mint_url`, but Nip60Wallet/Handle is referenced only in doc comments from nmp-wallet — it's a parallel abstraction NOT wired into the live cashu send path, so the money path is fully covered. Worth a follow-up issue, not a blocker.
